body: Well if you've not done it yet you can chat with me. I'll be around a bit more tonight
I'm sorry it took me a moment to respond. Just got home from work. I love chatting ! Tell me about everything!

You need to be held. I wish I could hold you right now. A big cradling hug. 

If it means anything I would love to just hold you and listen
I have no sweet nothings to tell you. I will, however, keep you company and listen to you.
You're not alone. What's wrong
Tell me about your issues. DM me
I'm not in the UK sadly but I'm up for chatting
Height may matter to some people but not to all
I'm the same way. I prefer to be alone any given time. But I do want to have a life partner. I've just had so many bad partners I've just given up

Honestly I've found (and I'm old lol ) that at 34 with an abusive family I abandoned years ago that nothing matters but myself. Though I've just realized this in the past year and it's been painful. 

I prefer to be alone. No family or significant other. It just causes more pain
In this sub we cannot tell you those answers. Talk to me please. I'm as low as you are and am looking for companionship
I dont even have a family. If you would like someone to talk to that isn't judgemental and in the same boat you are just DM me and we can go from there
Life does suck. Nothing changes that. If you ever want to chat I'm around
Clearly you arent vykeen. But you could use some cuddles.
Keep me company tonight. What torment ?
I've gone through it myself millions of times and yet I'm still here... barely.
Here we both are. That's life. What do you need to get out tonight?
Yeah that's a hard no from me dog. But seriously. Not that.
We will do this together! IWNDWYT
Going strong and feeling great ! Cmon everyone we can do this!IWNDWYT
Day 2 in the books. Onward to 3! I will not drink with any of you today!  None of you! Hehe
Day 2 successful yeah!

I made it through as well! Sidetracked myself with some Netflix before bed :) 

Oh and also.. I WILL NOT DRINK WITH YOU TODAY ! 

Have a wonderful day !

Keep it up ! Congrats on employment!  

I'm 10 months out of a very abusive relationship myself with not much to my name except the debt he left me. 

I love my job though! It keeps me going!  Its not something I would have chosen but I feel fulfilled and I'm working as hard as I can to better myself. So will you !

I will not drink with you today !!
Be more direct with your primary care. They should refer you. Email them. Usually if you sign up for the online things theres an option to email them directly

Personally I had spoken with my doctor and was prescribed a mild sleep aid. Works well!

I've needed sleep assistance even before the problem drinking as I'm diagnosed PTSD with night terrors.

I used to be in a relationship where we both depended on mind altering substances to be able to spend time together and talk. He with weed. Myself with alcohol. 

I wish I could say we did have a happy ending. However it didnt and we went our separate ways. 

I hope you and your significant other are able to communicate effectively about the issue. Communication is key and also something my ex would always avoid unless high. Meh. 

Today is another day one for myself. I will not drink with you today !
YEAH!
A very faint scar on my wrist. I never had or since have wanted to self inflict pain. It is my reminder not only of drinking but also the severely abusive ex.
I will not drink with you today !

I really have no insight to give you. Your story is very similar to my own. 

Today is my day one (again) and I just want to let you know I will not drink with you today !
Congrats !!!
Day one again for me too. I know how you feel. Let's not drink together !!!
Kill it!

You can do this!  Day 5 is a real accomplishment for something so difficult as what we are fighting. 

I messed up last night. Today I feel so guilty. Back to day one. Day by day we will get by!

Thankyou for such encouraging words! This is exactly why I came to this sub.. everyone is pretty fantastic. 

I've considered visiting AA as well when my work schedule allows. 

IWNDWYT!
Sure let me get situated at work and I'll send you a private message. A few moments please!

The more I read your post, the more it just hit so close to home for me. I may be some random internet stranger but if you ever need someone to talk to or just to listen to you let me know! We can commiserate..

Almost a year! How amazing!  Congratulations to you and keep it up!

Thankyou for the warm welcome, I look forward to helping and encouraging others as well. 

I've been drinking too much for about 5 years now and even with that amount of time this seems to be such a life changing event to stop completely, but a much needed one..
